caption:
Every service business runs on four systems, whether you built them on purpose or not.

Acquisition: are leads coming in at a cost you can sustain.
Instant follow-up: does every lead hear from you inside 5 minutes, any hour.
CRM operations: can you see every open lead in one place, right now.
Retention: do reviews, win-backs, and referrals run on a schedule.

Most owners pour all their attention into acquisition and let the other three run on hope. One weak system caps what the other three can do for you.

Run this on your shop this week. Whichever question makes you wince first is where the revenue is leaking.
